disposition_reason: Chromium, cadmium and lead were measured in clams bought at six open markets in Port Harcourt and Yenagoa.

study.market: three open markets in Port Harcourt (Rivers State) and three in Yenagoa (Bayelsa State), Nigeria
study.period_text: bi-weekly over three months (dates not reported)
study.method: oven drying, concentrated acid hot-plate digestion; Cr, Cd, Pb by flame AAS (Perkin-Elmer Analyst 300)
study.qa: triplicate analyses; no CRM, blanks or recovery reported

findings.notes: whole clam samples oven-dried above 50 °C before digestion (dry weight basis implied, not labelled); bi-weekly collection over 3 months, triplicate analyses; SD reflects triplicates
